---- MODULE W4Od3m1p4t4 ----
EXTENDS Integers, FiniteSets, TLC

Banks == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
MsgIds == {1, 2, 3}
SettleIds == {"t1", "t2", "t3"}
MAXCAP == 3

VARIABLES tokensAt, transit, batch, cap

vars == <<tokensAt, transit, batch, cap>>

\* A single ring token grants exclusive right to post into the settlement batch.
\* batch = the set of settlement instructions in the open batch; cap = the batch
\* capacity, adjusted at runtime. tokensAt/transit carry the one token around.
Ring == ("b1" :> "b2") @@ ("b2" :> "b3") @@ ("b3" :> "b1")

Init ==
    /\ tokensAt = [b \in Banks |-> IF b = "b1" THEN 1 ELSE 0]
    /\ transit = {}
    /\ batch = {}
    /\ cap = 2

\* The token holder posts one settlement instruction into the batch, only while
\* the batch is under capacity (exclusive access via the token).
Post(b, sid) ==
    /\ tokensAt[b] = 1
    /\ sid \notin batch
    /\ Cardinality(batch) < cap
    /\ batch' = batch \cup {sid}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokensAt, transit, cap>>

\* The token holder closes and settles the batch, emptying it.
Flush(b) ==
    /\ tokensAt[b] = 1
    /\ batch # {}
    /\ batch' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokensAt, transit, cap>>

\* The holder passes the single token to the next bank on the ring.
Pass(b, id) ==
    /\ tokensAt[b] = 1
    /\ ~ \E m \in transit : m.id = id
    /\ tokensAt' = [tokensAt EXCEPT ![b] = 0]
    /\ transit' = transit \cup {[id |-> id, to |-> Ring[b]]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batch, cap>>

\* The next bank receives the token.
Receive(m) ==
    /\ m \in transit
    /\ tokensAt' = [tokensAt EXCEPT ![m.to] = @ + 1]
    /\ transit' = transit \ {m}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<batch, cap>>

\* Capacity is raised at runtime.
Grow ==
    /\ cap < MAXCAP
    /\ cap' = cap + 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokensAt, transit, batch>>

\* Capacity is lowered at runtime, but never below what the batch already holds.
Shrink ==
    /\ cap > 0
    /\ Cardinality(batch) <= cap - 1
    /\ cap' = cap - 1
    /\ UNCHANGED <<tokensAt, transit, batch>>

Next ==
    \/ \E b \in Banks, sid \in SettleIds : Post(b, sid)
    \/ \E b \in Banks : Flush(b)
    \/ \E b \in Banks, id \in MsgIds : Pass(b, id)
    \/ \E m \in transit : Receive(m)
    \/ Grow
    \/ Shrink

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ tokensAt \in [Banks -> 0..1]
    /\ transit \subseteq [id : MsgIds, to : Banks]
    /\ batch \subseteq SettleIds
    /\ cap \in 0..MAXCAP

\* The open settlement batch never exceeds its current capacity, even as capacity
\* is raised and lowered at runtime.
BoundedCapacity == Cardinality(batch) <= cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl:
A bank's interbank settlement batch is assembled by member banks that take turns
using a token ring: a single token circulates around the ring, and only the bank
currently holding the token may post settlements into the open batch. The batch
has a capacity, and the token holder posts one settlement at a time only while
the batch is under capacity. The holder can also close and settle the batch,
emptying it. When done, the holder passes the single token to the next bank on
the ring, putting it in transit until that bank receives it. The batch capacity
is adjusted at runtime: it can be raised, and it can be lowered, but it is never
lowered below the number of settlements the batch already holds.
SAFETY PROPERTY: The open settlement batch never exceeds its current capacity, even as capacity is raised and lowered at runtime.

Nodes == {"n1", "n2"}
Courses == {"c1", "c2"}
MAXTERM == 3
MAXCAP == 2
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES leader, term, applied, seats, cap

vars == <<leader, term, applied, seats, cap>>

\* Only the current registrar leader may enroll. applied logs the enroll actions
\* taken during the current leadership term (reset on each new term). seats[c] =
\* current enrollment in course c; cap[c] = its seat capacity, changed at runtime.
Init ==
    /\ leader = "n1"
    /\ term = 1
    /\ applied = {}
    /\ seats = [c \in Courses |-> 0]
    /\ cap = [c \in Courses |-> 1]

\* per-term action log resets for the new term.

    /\ leader' = n
    /\ term' = term + 1
    /\ applied' = {}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<seats, cap>>

Enroll(n, c) ==
    /\ n = leader
    /\ seats[c] < cap[c]
    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ applied' = applied \cup {[node |-> n, course |-> c]}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, cap>>

    /\ seats' = [seats EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, applied, cap>>

    /\ cap[c] < MAXCAP
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![c] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, applied, seats>>

Shrink(c) ==
    /\ cap[c] > 0
    /\ seats[c] <= cap[c] - 1
    /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![c] = @ - 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<leader, term, applied, seats>>

    \/ \E n \in Nodes : Elect(n)
    \/ \E n \in Nodes, c \in Courses : Enroll(n, c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : Drop(c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : Grow(c)
    \/ \E c \in Courses : Shrink(c)

    /\ term \in 1..MAXTERM
    /\ applied \subseteq [node : Nodes, course : Courses]
    /\ seats \in [Courses -> 0..MAXCAP]
    /\ cap \in [Courses -> 0..MAXCAP]

\* in the current term was taken by the current leader.
NoStaleAction == \A a \in applied : a.node = leader

over. One node is the elected leader on a monotonically increasing term, and only
the current leader is authorized to enroll students; when leadership changes on a
higher term, the record of enroll actions for the new term starts fresh. The
current leader enrolls a student into a course that still has a free seat, and a
student may later drop, freeing a seat. Seat capacity for each course is adjusted
at runtime: it can be raised, and it can be lowered, but it is never lowered below
the course's current enrollment. A node that is not the current leader (a stale
or superseded registrar) must never enroll anyone.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No unauthorized or stale registrar ever enrolls a student; every enroll action recorded in the current term was taken by the current leader.

---- MODULE W4Od3m7p0t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Workers == {"A1", "A2", "B1"}
CAP == 2
MAXG == 4
NONE == "none"

VARIABLES lock, gen, pc, ledger

vars == <<lock, gen, pc, ledger>>

\* lock is the compare-and-swap register guarding the shared settlement ledger
\* (the critical resource); gen counts successful acquisitions. Workers belong to
\* two independent settlement instances (A*, B*) sharing the one ledger.
Init ==
    /\ lock = NONE
    /\ gen = 0
    /\ pc = [w \in Workers |-> "idle"]
    /\ ledger = 0

\* A worker starts contending for the lock.
Attempt(w) ==
    /\ pc[w] = "idle"
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "trying"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, gen, ledger>>

\* Compare-and-swap the free register to this worker, entering the critical
\* section and bumping the acquisition generation.
AcquireCAS(w) ==
    /\ pc[w] = "trying"
    /\ lock = NONE
    /\ gen < MAXG
    /\ lock' = w
    /\ gen' = gen + 1
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "cs"]
    /\ UNCHANGED ledger

\* The CAS could not proceed (register taken, or generation ceiling reached), so
\* the worker backs off and will retry.
FailBackoff(w) ==
    /\ pc[w] = "trying"
    /\ (lock # NONE) \/ (gen = MAXG)
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, gen, ledger>>

\* Inside the critical section the worker posts to the shared ledger.
Work(w) ==
    /\ pc[w] = "cs"
    /\ lock = w
    /\ ledger < CAP
    /\ ledger' = ledger + 1
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "done"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<lock, gen>>

\* Release compare-and-swaps the register back to free.
Release(w) ==
    /\ pc[w] \in {"cs", "done"}
    /\ lock = w
    /\ lock' = NONE
    /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![w] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<gen, ledger>>

Next ==
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Attempt(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : AcquireCAS(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : FailBackoff(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Work(w)
    \/ \E w \in Workers : Release(w)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ lock \in Workers \cup {NONE}
    /\ gen \in 0..MAXG
    /\ pc \in [Workers -> {"idle", "trying", "cs", "done"}]
    /\ ledger \in 0..CAP

\* Mutual exclusion of the shared ledger: any worker inside or holding the
\* critical section is the lock register's current owner, so at most one worker is
\* ever inside at a time.
MutualExclusion ==
    \A w \in Workers : (pc[w] \in {"cs", "done"}) => (lock = w)
====

NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion

A bank's interbank settlement batch is assembled through a shared settlement
ledger, the critical resource. Two independent settlement instances (with workers
A1, A2 and B1) share that one ledger, and access is guarded by a single
compare-and-swap lock register. A worker first starts contending for the lock,
then compare-and-swaps the free register to itself: if the register still reads
free (and the acquisition-generation ceiling has not been reached) it wins the
lock, bumps the acquisition generation, and enters the critical section. If the
register was already taken by another worker, or the generation ceiling is
reached, the CAS could not proceed and the worker backs off to retry. Inside the
critical section the worker posts to the shared ledger, then releases the lock by
compare-and-swapping the register back to free.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At most one worker is ever inside the critical section, because any worker inside or holding it is the lock register's single current owner.

---- MODULE W4Od15m2p4t2 ----
EXTENDS Integers

Instances == {"A", "B"}
Levels == {"L1", "L2"}
CAP == 2
PARTS == 2

VARIABLES book, phase, prop, yes, no

vars == <<book, phase, prop, yes, no>>

Phases == {"idle", "voting", "committed", "aborted"}

\* book is the shared order book (fill per price level), a single pool that two
\* independent matching-engine instances write into. Each instance runs its own
\* two-phase-commit round; prop[i] is the level i is trying to fill, and yes[i]/
\* no[i] count the votes gathered from the two participants in i's round.
Init ==
    /\ book = [l \in Levels |-> 0]
    /\ phase = [i \in Instances |-> "idle"]
    /\ prop = [i \in Instances |-> "L1"]
    /\ yes = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
    /\ no = [i \in Instances |-> 0]

\* An instance opens a round to admit one more order at a level.
Propose(i, l) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "idle"
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "voting"]
    /\ prop' = [prop EXCEPT ![i] = l]
    /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ no' = [no EXCEPT ![i] = 0]
    /\ UNCHANGED book

\* A participant in instance i's round votes yes.
VoteYes(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ yes[i] + no[i] < PARTS
    /\ yes' = [yes EXCEPT ![i] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, phase, prop, no>>

\* A participant in instance i's round votes no.
VoteNo(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ yes[i] + no[i] < PARTS
    /\ no' = [no EXCEPT ![i] = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, phase, prop, yes>>

\* Commit requires all participants yes AND spare capacity at the target level in
\* the shared book; it fills one slot.
Commit(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ yes[i] = PARTS
    /\ book[prop[i]] < CAP
    /\ book' = [book EXCEPT ![prop[i]] = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "committed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<prop, yes, no>>

\* The round aborts once everyone voted and it is not a unanimous yes with room.
Abort(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] = "voting"
    /\ yes[i] + no[i] = PARTS
    /\ ~(yes[i] = PARTS /\ book[prop[i]] < CAP)
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "aborted"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, prop, yes, no>>

Reset(i) ==
    /\ phase[i] \in {"committed", "aborted"}
    /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![i] = "idle"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<book, prop, yes, no>>

Next ==
    \/ \E i \in Instances, l \in Levels : Propose(i, l)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : VoteYes(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : VoteNo(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Commit(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Abort(i)
    \/ \E i \in Instances : Reset(i)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

TypeOK ==
    /\ book \in [Levels -> 0..CAP]
    /\ phase \in [Instances -> Phases]
    /\ prop \in [Instances -> Levels]
    /\ yes \in [Instances -> 0..PARTS]
    /\ no \in [Instances -> 0..PARTS]

\* No price level in the shared order book is ever filled beyond its capacity, even
\* though two independent instances commit into the same pool.
BoundedCapacity == \A l \in Levels : book[l] <= CAP
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BoundedCapacity
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction is run by two independent matching-engine
instances that share one order book. Each price level in the shared book has a
hard capacity. To admit one more order at a level, an instance runs its own
two-phase-commit round: it opens a round for a level, and the two participants in
that round each cast a yes or no vote. The round commits only if both
participants voted yes and the target level in the shared book still has spare
capacity, in which case one slot is filled; if the vote is not a unanimous yes,
or the level has no room, the round aborts. After committing or aborting, the
instance resets and can open another round. Because both instances commit into
the same shared book, each commit re-checks capacity against the live book.
SAFETY PROPERTY: No price level in the shared order book is ever filled beyond its capacity, even though two independent instances commit into the same pool.
